Music Programming at The Pembroke

The Pembroke is building something exciting: a club that aims to redefine what a London members' club should be - an eclectic home for culture, curiosity and community.

As programming partner, our role would be to translate that vision into a musical identity: curating artists, shaping atmosphere and delivering a programme that is refined, cohesive and seamless behind the scenes. And making sure we're all having fun doing it!

Vision & Principles

Our curation is built around music that evolves naturally with the energy of the evening - warm, accessible and inviting from first arrivals through to late night. Each night unfolds through changing sounds, tempos and energy, creating a natural musical journey.
DJs are selected above all for their musical taste, range and ability to read the room, bringing an eclectic, culturally curious soundtrack that balances timeless records with unexpected discoveries. The programme evolves with the seasons, London's cultural calendar and the rhythm of the club.
Deeply rooted in London's music scene, our resident DJs bring style, charisma, professionalism, and cultural awareness, equally at home setting the tone over cocktails as they are building energy on a packed dancefloor.

How We Refine the Programme

The Power of Partnership

  • DJs who genuinely understand the club and its members
  • Greater consistency across every night of the week, month and year
  • Better talent at better rates through regular bookings
  • A stronger sense of identity and community
  • Long-term cultural moments that members anticipate

Working Together

The partnership can be structured in a number of ways, depending on the scale and ambition of the programme. In practice, we envisage a model that combines ongoing programming delivery with artist bookings, evolving alongside the club as it grows.

About Us

Combining experience across luxury hospitality, cultural programming and live entertainment, we create music experiences tailored not only to a venue or event, but to the people, atmosphere and moments that define it.

Rory MacInnes

Founder of Miro Sounds, specialising in bespoke music curation for private clients, luxury hospitality and cultural spaces. With experience spanning music, events and technology - including recently as Chief Commercial Officer at music events powerhouse XCEED - Rory has worked at the intersection of nightlife, entertainment and hospitality, helping bring world-class artists to the world's leading venues, festivals and private events.

Charlie Kelly

With experience spanning private members' clubs, artist relations and audience development, Charlie was Head of Music & Member Events at The Arts Club, overseeing hundreds of performances and shaping the soundtrack of one of London's most established cultural institutions. Now at Toolroom, the UK's most influential electronic music label, Charlie combines a deep understanding of music culture with an instinct for programming, community and nightlife.
